WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM event_averages
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, oa.average_amount AS overall_average
    FROM event_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE ea.average_amount > oa.average_amount
), kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT ao.link_to_event,
       ao.average_amount,
       ao.average_amount - ao.overall_average AS above_overall_average,
       ao.average_amount - ka.average_amount AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM above_overall ao
CROSS JOIN kept_average ka
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
